albert.enterKey: Enter your Albert API key to get started.
albert.whereKey: Where do I find my key?
albert.name: Albert - DINUM
albert.envKey: An ALBERT_API_KEY variable exists on this computer: save the key here to use it in Cimes.

skills.title: Skills
skills.intro: Expert instructions the agent loads when your request matches. Compatible with Claude skills (a folder with a SKILL.md file). Scripts never run without your approval.
skills.pageIntro: Expert instructions the agent loads when your request matches. Import your own skills in Claude format.
skills.importedScripts: It contains scripts ({{scripts}}): they only run with your approval.

documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: Your documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text) that the agent can consult to answer.
documents.settingsIntro: Add documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Markdown, text). The agent consults them with the "search_docs" tool when your question relates to them. Files stay where they are; Cimes keeps an index on this computer.
documents.modeLocalHelp: A small model shipped with Cimes computes meaning-based search on the processor. Nothing leaves the computer; the first analysis takes a while.
documents.modeAlbertHelp: Sends excerpts of your documents to Albert to compute vectors: faster, requires the network.
documents.modeKeywordsHelp: Search by the words of the question, without meaning analysis.
documents.modelMissing: Model not installed in this version.
documents.searchIntro: Ask a question: these are the excerpts the agent would receive.
documents.searchPlaceholder: For example: what does the policy say about tablets?
documents.noHits: No excerpt found. Try other words.

webSearch.label: Web search server (SearXNG)
webSearch.invalid: Enter a full address, for example https://search.example.org
webSearch.help: Left empty, the agent searches DuckDuckGo then Bing, without a key. If your organisation has a SearXNG server (JSON format enabled), enter it here: searches will be more reliable.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.intro: Connect plugins (MCP servers) to give the agent new tools: up-to-date documentation, memory, browser… Each tool call asks for your approval. "npx" servers require Node.js to be installed on this computer.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.intro: What the agent did recently (tools, turns, errors). Useful to understand a problem or to attach to a bug report. File contents are never recorded.

official.title: Official sources
official.intro: The agent can look up official French public data: open datasets, the public services directory, organisations and companies, addresses and public procurement notices. These need no key.
official.legifranceHelp: Needs a free PISTE application (piste.gouv.fr) subscribed to the Légifrance API. Paste its client ID and secret here.
